definitions.explanation: Matters and events happening in the world at the present time, especially in politics, economics, and society. Used as a compound modifier before other nouns.

examples.japanese: {時事|じじ}⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦チェックしている→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I check the current affairs news every day.

examples.japanese: {時事|じじ}{問題|もんだい}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}められた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: I was asked for my opinion on current affairs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時事|じじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問|と}われる→問う：02299_tou⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Employment exams often test knowledge of current affairs.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used as a compound modifier: {時事|じじ} + noun. Rarely stands alone. Formal register, common in news media, education, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {時事|じじ}{問題|もんだい}: current affairs issues
- {時事|じじ}⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧: current affairs news
- {時事|じじ}⟦{解説|かいせつ}→解説：00138_kaisetsu⟧: current affairs commentary
- {時事|じじ}⟦{評論|ひょうろん}→評論：05820_hyouron⟧: current affairs criticism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {時事|じじ}⟦{通信|つうしん}→通信：03514_tsuushin⟧: Jiji Press (major Japanese news agency — proper noun, not to be confused)
- ⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧: news (general)
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧: the world, society (everyday)
